identification: Round English dial wall clock, approx 12 inch, cream painted dial, Roman numerals, unsigned, spade hands, turned oak or mahogany surround, glazed bezel. Movement not seen: single fusee (worth AUD 150-300 at auction) versus plain going-barrel or later German or American movement (worth AUD 40-100). Similar Gowans dial/railway clocks sold AUD 160-320 hammer.
